description: Investing.com economic calendar for a date range (up to 7 days): each release with UTC time, country, currency, event name, category, importance (low/medium/high), reference period, actual, forecast and previous values with unit, Investing's actual-vs-forecast verdict, preliminary flag and the publishing source. Filter by country code, currency or minimum importance. Read from the API the Investing.com calendar page calls. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, TR

to.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD, at most 7 days after from (default = from)
